title: Update Helicopter rescue sim update: 7 days in, and I’m already vibecoding & flying it daily :D
author: Huge_Veterinarian572
selftext:
was honestly blown away by your feedback on my first post. Thanks for all the encouragement, questions, and suggestions, it made me want to share more of the progress with you.

Here’s the next update with some clips from gameplay and flying around Zürich

Visually, I’d say the map is about 60% of where I want it to be. Some areas look amazing when everything loads properly; getting that to happen consistently is another story 😅

A few answers:

* **Where does the map come from?** Google Maps Platform’s Photorealistic 3D Tiles, streamed through Cesium for Unity, with additional Swiss building data from swisstopo and road/railway data from OpenStreetMap. My current focus is Birrfeld, Zurich, and Bern.
* **Did AI generate all the buildings and helicopters?** No. To clarify my earlier reply: Astra and Unity MCP are my development tools, but the scenery comes from existing geographic datasets. I’ve also purchased helicopter assets for the prototype to improve the visuals. The original asset creators deserve that credit.
* **What do you actually do?** The focus is helicopter rescue: flying to an incident, landing, picking up a patient, and transporting them to a hospital. I want to get that basic mission loop working well before expanding into lots of different mission types.
* **Can you fly from the cockpit or use a joystick?** Yes, cockpit flying and joystick controls are already part of the prototype. Camera behaviour and visibility still need work.
* **What platform is it running on?** My MacBook! This started because I wanted a helicopter rescue sim I could enjoy on my own Mac. A first closed beta would focus on macOS.
* **What was the $250?** That was the AI-credit spending mentioned in the first post, not a selling price or a complete budget for the finished game.

  
**I’m also planning a Steam page so people can wishlist it later.** Before sharing a playable build, I still need to sort out commercial licensing for the map services

our outside from Steam, if somebody have a Macbook let me know, to test it.

comments.author: bonsoir-world
comments.body:
Curious how you got maps into the game?

I had both Gemini and Claude build a game that didn’t even directly use Google Maps/Tiles in game but to procedurally generate things based on the map images and was shit down repeatedly.

The reason was use of maps for your own services is actually forbidden.

Even the guys that made Pokemon Go had to move away from Google.

In the end i had to use some public map options, which just didn’t provide what I needed.

Tried the same with Bing Maps, like Microsoft Flight Sim uses and was basically told the same.

I guess you guy work/prompt around it but it means rebuilding the game once it’s at a state you’re happy with.

So also just a warning ahead of time too, if you didn’t know!

comments.author: work_in_marketing
comments.body: SimCopter in your local neighbourhood is a really fun idea. My only concern about using the Google maps is that it looks really rough when you land. SimCopter got away with it because that was the style - and frankly - limitations of the age. Maybe it would be possible to replace some standardized textures for say grass, highways, road, trees, and so on. But maybe that's what you're already doing considering the hospital pad looks fairly highres.
